questions.subject: english
questions.question: John Keats was a great English .......... poet.
questions.explanation: John Keats अंग्रेजी साहित्य के महान Romantic कवियों में से एक थे।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Where was John Keats born?
questions.explanation: John Keats का जन्म Moonfields, London में हुआ था।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was John Keats born?
questions.explanation: John Keats का जन्म सन् 1795 में हुआ था।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: When did John Keats pass away?
questions.explanation: John Keats का निधन सन् 1821 में मात्र 26 वर्ष की आयु में हुआ था।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: is taken from ..........
questions.explanation: यह पंक्ति John Keats द्वारा रचित 'Ode to Autumn' के प्रथम पद से ली गई है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: is from ..........
questions.explanation: यह पंक्ति 'Ode to Autumn' के दूसरे पद (Stanza 2) से ली गई है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which season is called the season of 'mellow fruitfulness'?
questions.explanation: कविता की पहली पंक्ति में Autumn (शरद ऋतु) को 'Season of mists and mellow fruitfulness' कहा गया है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Autumn is conspiring with .......... to load and bless the vines.
questions.explanation: Autumn परिपक्व होते हुए सूर्य (maturing sun) के साथ मिलकर योजना बनाती है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Where does the vine run around in the poem?
questions.explanation: कविता के अनुसार बेलें घास-फूस की छतों के किनारों (thatch-eaves) के चारों ओर फैली हैं।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who is the close bosom-friend of the maturing sun?
questions.explanation: Autumn को परिपक्व होते सूर्य का 'close bosom-friend' बताया गया है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who think that warm days will never cease?
questions.explanation: मधुमक्खियाँ (bees) सोचती हैं कि गर्म दिन कभी समाप्त नहीं होंगे क्योंकि छत्ते शहद से भर चुके हैं।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Where can Autumn be found sitting careless?
questions.explanation: कविता में Autumn को अनाज के भंडार के फर्श (granary floor) पर निश्चिंत बैठे दिखाया गया है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Autumn is personified as a .......... in the second stanza.
questions.explanation: दूसरे पद में Autumn का मानवीकरण खेत में काम करने वाली ग्रामीण महिला/मजदूर के रूप में किया गया है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is Autumn doing on a half-reap'd furrow?
questions.explanation: पॉपीज (खसखस) के फूलों की महक से Autumn आधे कटे खेत की मेड़ पर गहरी नींद में सोई हुई दिखाई देती है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Lamia' and 'Hyperion' are celebrated works composed by ..........
questions.explanation: 'Lamia' और 'Hyperion' जॉन कीट्स की प्रमुख काव्य रचनाएँ हैं।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which bird whistles with treble soft from a garden-croft?
questions.explanation: कविता की पंक्ति है: 'The red-breast whistles from a garden-croft'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What are twittering in the skies in the evening?
questions.explanation: कविता की अंतिम पंक्ति है: 'And gathering swallows twitter in the skies'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who has composed the lyrical poem 'Ode to Autumn'?
questions.explanation: 'Ode to Autumn' की रचना जॉन कीट्स (John Keats) ने की है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Season of mists and mellow fruitfulness' is the opening line of ..........
questions.explanation: यह प्रसिद्ध पंक्ति 'Ode to Autumn' कविता की सबसे पहली पंक्ति है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Ode to Autumn' belongs to which poetic genre?
questions.explanation: 'Ode to Autumn' विधा के रूप में एक Ode (प्रशंसा/संबोधन गीत) है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In 'Ode to Autumn', Keats deals with which season in detail?
questions.explanation: इस कविता में कवि शरद ऋतु (Autumn) के सौंदर्य और समृद्धि का विस्तृत वर्णन करते हैं।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Ode to Autumn' consists of how many stanzas in total?
questions.explanation: 'Ode to Autumn' कुल तीन पदों (three stanzas) में संरचित है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The central theme of Autumn in this poem is ..........
questions.explanation: कविता का मुख्य विषय प्रकृति की परिपक्वता, पूर्णता (maturity and abundance) का उत्सव मनाना है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which season has been personified throughout 'Ode to Autumn'?
questions.explanation: पूरी कविता में शरद ऋतु (Autumn) का एक सजीव पात्र के रूप में मानवीकरण किया गया है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In 'Ode to Autumn', Autumn is depicted as a season of mellow ..........
questions.explanation: कवि ने इसे 'mellow fruitfulness' (फलों की मधुर परिपक्वता) का मौसम कहा है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Autumn starts with the departure of which season?
questions.explanation: शरद ऋतु गर्मियों (Summer) के खत्म होने के बाद शुरू होती है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Among the following poets, who was an ardent lover of nature and sensory beauty?
questions.explanation: जॉन कीट्स प्रकृति के सौंदर्य और इंद्रियगत अनुभवों (sensuous beauty) के अप्रतिम कवि थे।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which season do trees shed their leaves and prepare for new buds?
questions.explanation: Autumn (पतझड़/शरद) में पेड़ पुराने पत्ते गिराते हैं और फसलें पकती हैं।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What has over-brimmed the clammy cells of the bees?
questions.explanation: कविता की पंक्ति है: 'For Summer has o'er-brimm'd their clammy cells'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which fruit is specifically mentioned as bending the moss'd cottage trees?
questions.explanation: पंक्ति है: 'To bend with apples the moss'd cottage-trees'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: At what age did John Keats pass away?
questions.explanation: जॉन कीट्स का देहांत मात्र 26 वर्ष की आयु में हो गया था।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which fatal disease caused the untimely death of John Keats in 1821?
questions.explanation: उनकी मृत्यु क्षय रोग यानी Tuberculosis (टीबी) के कारण हुई थी।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Where did John Keats receive his school education?
questions.explanation: कीट्स ने Enfield स्थित Clarke's School में अपनी स्कूली शिक्षा प्राप्त की थी।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which sports was John Keats deeply interested during his school days?
questions.explanation: वे स्कूल के दिनों में क्रिकेट और मुक्केबाजी (cricket and boxing) में अत्यधिक रुचि रखते थे।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Keats's ambition to become a poet was fired by reading Edmund Spenser's ..........
questions.explanation: स्पेंसर की 'The Faerie Queene' पढ़ने के पश्चात कीट्स में कवि बनने की तीव्र लालसा जागी।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was the title of John Keats's first published poem in 1814?
questions.explanation: उनकी पहली प्रकाशित कविता 'Lines in Imitation of Spenser' थी।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which poem by Keats published in 1818 was well appreciated by William Wordsworth?
questions.explanation: कीट्स की रचना 'Endymion' की विलियम वर्ड्सवर्थ ने प्रशंसा की थी।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Complete the famous quote by Keats: 'A thing of beauty is a ..........'
questions.explanation: जॉन कीट्स का प्रसिद्ध कथन है: 'A thing of beauty is a joy forever'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to Keats in 'Ode on a Grecian Urn', 'Beauty is truth, truth ..........'
questions.explanation: कीट्स का प्रसिद्ध काव्यात्मक सूत्र है: 'Beauty is truth, truth beauty'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Each of the three stanzas in 'Ode to Autumn' contains how many lines?
questions.explanation: 'Ode to Autumn' के प्रत्येक पद में ठीक 11 पंक्तियाँ हैं (कुल 33 पंक्तियाँ)।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In Stanza 1, what fills all fruit with ripeness to the ..........?
questions.explanation: पंक्ति है: 'And fill all fruit with ripeness to the core'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does Autumn swell and plump with a sweet kernel in the first stanza?
questions.explanation: कविता में लिखा है: 'To swell the gourd, and plump the hazel shells With a sweet kernel'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: By what is Autumn's hair soft-lifted while sitting on the granary floor?
questions.explanation: पंक्ति है: 'Thy hair soft-lifted by the winnowing wind'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Autumn is drowsed with the perfume and fume of which flower?
questions.explanation: खसखस (poppies) के मादक प्रभाव से Autumn आधे कटे खेत पर ऊंघती हुई सो जाती है ('Drowsed with the fume of poppies')।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the second stanza, Autumn balances a laden head steadily across a ..........
questions.explanation: पंक्ति है: 'And sometimes like a gleaner thou dost keep Steady thy laden head across a brook'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which apparatus does Autumn watch with patient look for hours together?
questions.explanation: Autumn सेब का रस टपकने वाले यंत्र (cider-press) के पास घंटों बैठकर अंतिम बूंदें देखती है।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the third stanza, barred clouds bloom the soft-dying day and touch the plains with a ..........
questions.explanation: पंक्ति है: 'And touch the stubble-plains with rosy hue'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which insects mourn in a wailful choir along the river sallows?
questions.explanation: नदी के कछारों में छोटे मच्छर (small gnats) शोकपूर्ण सामूहिक स्वर में विलाप करते हैं।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: From where do full-grown lambs loud bleat in the evening?
questions.explanation: पंक्ति है: 'And full-grown lambs loud bleat from hilly bourn'।

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What sound does the hedge-cricket make in the final stanza?
questions.explanation: कविता में लिखा है: 'Hedge-crickets sing'।
